entries.en: What a surprise – visiting hours canceled again. Those fuckers...
entries.ro: Ce surpriză – iar au anulat programul de vizite. Nenorociții ăia...

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="そんな汚い言葉どこで覚えたの！？" t="Who taught you to swear like that?!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="そんな汚い言葉どこで覚えたの！？" t="Cine te-a învățat să înjuri așa?!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Hm, let's see, maybe my skull-sponged excuse of a dad who can't even get his own family to visit him?!
entries.ro: Hm, să vedem, poate tatăl meu ăla cu creierul de burete, care nici familia nu și-o poate aduce să-l vadă?!

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="な… 何言ってるの？" t="What? What does that mean?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="な… 何言ってるの？" t="Ce? Ce înseamnă asta?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Don't ask me to come here anymore. It's a fucking waste of time...
entries.ro: Nu mă mai ruga să vin aici. E o pierdere de timp de căcat...

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="あなたのお父さんなのよ…" t="But he's your father..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="あなたのお父さんなのよ…" t="Dar e tatăl tău..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: If he was a real father, he wouldn't have gotten himself thrown in jail! And then, we come all this way, and he can't even bribe the guards?!
entries.ro: Dacă ar fi fost un tată adevărat, nu s-ar fi lăsat băgat la închisoare! Și noi ne târâm până aici, iar el nici gardienii nu-i poate mitui?!
